item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 Tinubu source on biological-risk governance, export controls, formal AI safety rules, or catastrophe-specific dual-use review boards. I also found no direct evidence of a published AI-risk assessment, biosafety audit, or other explicit precaution framework under Tinubu in 2024. So the best-supported conclusion is: public cooperation and digital capacity-building on the positive side, but weak explicit safety governance and at least some cyber-rights risk on the negative side.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Meets FBI Director, Calls for Stronger Collaboration to Fight Cybercrime and Terrorism","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 14, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-meets-fbi-director-calls-for-stronger-collaboration-to-fight-cybercrime-and-terrorism/","summary":"Tinubu publicly sought stronger Nigeria-U.S. cooperation against cybercrime and terrorism and asked for technology and knowledge transfer to combat complex international crimes. This is a clear positive signal for handling cyber risk through inter-agency collaboration rather than secrecy or improvisation.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.8","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu to Meta: Nigeria Poised to Lead Africa in Digital Technology","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"March 21, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-to-meta-nigeria-poised-to-lead-africa-in-digital-technology/","summary":"Tinubu said his administration was sustaining investments in digital technology, deepening capacity, and fostering partnerships to keep Nigeria competitive in ICT. This supports a precautionary reading only indirectly, but it does show public, partnership-based management of a fast-moving digital domain.","question_ids":["1B.9"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Directs Prioritization of Digital Infrastructure Investment to Enhance Business Efficiency and Productivity","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"March 14, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-prioritization-of-digital-infrastructure-investment-to-enhance-business-efficiency-and-productivity/","summary":"Tinubu ordered ministries to align regulations and tax frameworks to accelerate broadband and telecom investment, and complained about bureaucratic delay. This is relevant to dual-use technology governance because it shows public regulation of critical digital infrastructure, though not explicit AI or cyber-risk management.","question_ids":["1B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria, U.S. Agree to Harness Artificial Intelligence, Facilitate Data Flows and Empower Digital Upskilling; Issue Joint Statement","publisher":"Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy","date":"July 27, 2024","url":"https://fmcide.gov.ng/u-s-nigeria-reach-agreement-to-harness-artificial-intelligence-facilitate-data-flows-and-empower-digital-upskilling-issue-joint-statement/","summary":"Nigeria and the U.S. publicly agreed to cooperate on AI, data flows, and workforce upskilling, with the stated goal of building digital capacity. This is the strongest direct 2024 AI-related evidence and is transparently announced rather than hidden from public view.","question_ids":["1B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House noted that the Cybercrimes Act was amended in February 2024 and that the cyberstalking provision has frequently been used against journalists and activists. This is the clearest negative signal in the record for precaution/transparency: cyber policy still carried misuse and repression risk.","question_ids":["1B.9"]}]}
